title: VendPoint Vend Pricing and Monthly Usage Invoicing Standard
content:
Billing standard for vends on the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program.

**1. When a machine vends.** A machine vends only while its status is active or suspended, and while suspended only items in the model's credit hold safety categories on a model whose credit hold vending rule is safety items only.

**2. Vend price.** Each vend is billed at the contract unit price the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement price basis gives for the vend date, under the model's vend price basis; title passes on the vend.

**3. Daily vend limit.** A badge vends at most the model's daily vend limit in units per day unless the customer has set another limit.

**4. Cost centers.** A machine bills to at most the model's maximum number of cost centers.

**5. Monthly invoice.** Under the model's vend billing cycle, net vends of a calendar month (vends less returns and vend errors dated in the month, plus shrink billed in the month) are billed on one invoice dated the last day of the month, split per cost center where the model has cost center billing and billed as one ALL invoice otherwise; a return or error credit is netted in the month it occurs even when the original vend was billed in an earlier month.

**6. One bill per cost center.** Each machine is billed at most once per cost center for a billing month.

### Evidence

- Clause 1 rests on the machine's status as the system record shows it before the vend, for the same machine.
- Clause 6 rests on the machine's usage bills already on record for the same machine, the same billing month and the same cost center.

### Input, judgement, result

| Input | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Machine status active | Clause 1 met | The machine vends |
| Machine status suspended, item in a credit hold safety category, model rule safety items only | Clause 1 met | The item vends |
| Machine status suspended, model rule lock machine | Clause 1 not met | Nothing vends |
| A usage bill already on record for the machine, month and cost center | Clause 6 | No second bill for that machine, month and cost center |

### Hypothetical month

A machine with cost center billing shows, in one calendar month, vends of 900.00 USD for cost center A, a return of 50.00 USD for cost center A of an item vended the month before, and no shrink. Cost center A is billed 850.00 USD on the invoice dated the last day of the month: the return is netted in the month it occurs. The amounts are illustrative.
